text:
sam: FYI the aggregates-hr backfill from last night got routed into the low-priority lane and never made progress after 03:10 UTC. job-id=job_20260318_0310. I think the new SLO routing rule is over-eager.

jen: ugh. which rule matched? was it the 'background-recompute' default or the new slo-driven bucket?

sam: looks like slo-driven bucket. The rule matched by `latency_budget_ms` = 200 and tenant quota < 0.5. The tenant had a temporary quota dip due to a billing sync.

mike: can you paste the matched routing decision from the router logs?

sam: router log snippet:
```
{ "job_id": "job_20260318_0310", "tenant": "acme-plat", "decision": "low_priority_lane", "reason": "slo_bucket: background-recompute (latency_budget=200ms) -> quota_fraction=0.42" }
```

anil: so the router is using the live quota fraction which can fluctuate. That makes backfills fragile. Proposed: use a snapshot quota for scheduling decisions (10m TTL) or have a backfill preflight that pins a quota snapshot.

jen: totally. Also the console UX currently shows "queued" with no ETA. Ops couldn't tell if stuck vs slow. We should add an "estimated completion" and a "routing bucket" field in the backfill run detail panel.

leo: +1 to ETA. We can compute a rough ETA from historical throughput for that tenant/model combo. It would be coarse but good.

mike: implementation notes: two changes: (1) router: fall back to snapshot quota when job_origin=="console-backfill" OR when job_age < 1h; (2) console: preflight endpoint that returns estimated_tokens, estimated_time, and recommended priority. Example preflight API: `POST /v1/internal/backfill/preflight` with body `{job_spec}` and response `{eta_seconds, required_capacity, recommended_bucket}`.

sam: would we need new RBAC for that internal API? Support/SEs shouldn't invoke it directly unless allowed.

anil: internal API protected by service token + console session scope. That's fine. We'll log every preflight in telemetry.

jen: UX idea: in the backfill create modal add a "safety" slider: Conservative <-> Aggressive which maps to recommended_bucket and whether to auto-retry into higher-priority lanes (with approval). Default Conservative. Also show estimated cost delta if you pick Aggressive.

mike: that requires linking to optimize recommendations (quantization/batch window) to show cost delta. We already have cost model per token per bucket. Small lift.

leo: for immediate mitigation, can we backfill the stuck job manually to mid-priority? ops-bot, can you escalate job_20260318_0310 to priority=mid?

ops-bot: @sam request received: escalating job_20260318_0310 -> mid_priority. Action queued (task 98431). Will notify when rescheduled. :rocket:

sam: thanks. For the longer term, propose a triage doc and a quick patch: prefer snapshot quota for console-origin backfills and expose preflight API. I'll open a PR with a router change and a console preflight endpoint.

anil: add tests that simulate quota flaps and ensure console backfills aren't tombstoned. Also add an alert in telemetry when many backfills hit 'low_priority' and don't progress for >30m.

jen: agreed. Can someone draft the console mockups? I can do quick Figma frames for the slider + ETA panel.

mike: i'll take the router change and tests. anil you take telemetry alert and ops-bot integration. jen do the mockups. sam will own the preflight API and wire up the console.

sam: timeline? we should aim for a small hotfix (router snapshot) by EOD and UX + preflight next sprint.

jen: EOD sounds good for the snapshot change. I'll schedule a quick sync at 11:30 to review the mockups and the messaging (what to show in 'estimated completion').

mike: note to self: patch diff will change routing decision order. pseudo: 
```
if job.origin == "console-backfill":
  quota = repo.get_quota_snapshot(tenant, ttl=600)
else:
  quota = live_quota
// existing matching on slo buckets
```

anil: I'll add an alert rule: `count(backfill_jobs{state="low_priority", progress="stalled"} > 0) by tenant > 5 over 30m` -> page.

jen: thanks all. I'll post Figma link after noon. Sam open the PRs and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:

sam: created PR #4123 for router snapshot and opened draft issue for preflight API. tagging @mike @anil @jen for reviews.

mike: reviewed and left minor comments. Approving once tests green.

ops-bot: job_20260318_0310 rescheduled into mid_priority at 2026-03-18T05:12:40Z.

sam: nice. keeping this open till console shows ETA and preflight is in. Closing after the sprint work is merged.
